scope: All 29 New York assets: seven families at levels1/2/3 plus eight public buildings.
method: Read current production PNG renders and active metropolitan.py code. Inspect complete contact sheets, then targeted individual and before/after renders. Validate all PNG/GLB hashes. No AI generation; only four confirmed defects rebuilt.
inspectionViews: active source geometry and numeric placement
limits: This is a facade-construction audit of the available production view plus source, not a claim that every possible camera angle has a new render.

repairs.rootCause: landmark_core placed a 1.45-high domestic window at z=.55 before the shopfront. Its head reached z=2.00, above the storefront glass top 1.55 and canopy, leaving two green frame fragments and stone heads visible above the awning.
repairs.fix: Reserve both ground-floor front bays for the bespoke shopfront; omit only the two domestic windows. Upper storey windows, all side/rear facades, clerestory, roof and awning remain.

repairs.rootCause: public created arched windows at x=-1 and +1 before placing the map board at x=-.37 (width1.39) and the door at x=.87. The left window extends outside the board edge; the right arch remains above a door whose centre is offset by .13, producing a visibly misaligned remnant.
repairs.fix: Reserve both front bays for the map board and offset entrance; omit generic windows only for junction_hub. Keep side/rear glazing, upper arched bay, map, signpost and canopy.

repairs.rootCause: Side-tower crests incorrectly used the shorter central-hall height body+.30: z=2.90 with height .72. The three-storey wing top-floor glazing starts at z=2.85 and ends at3.53, so the crest crossed the real window.
repairs.fix: Use tower_mass returned side_top=3.75; crest base is3.87 with height .60, entirely above the top window and within the existing stepped roof envelope. Main building and roof geometry are unchanged.
repairs.source: large finance: side_top returned by tower_mass

repairs.rootCause: The inherited crest used central-hall body+.30=5.20 although the side tower has five floors. Top-floor glazing is z=5.15..5.83, so the old crest was directly over it. This duplicates the separate new L3 rooftop crest at6.12.
repairs.fix: Remove only the obsolete low crest on each wing. Preserve the separate rooftop crests, pinnacles, rotunda, full-height central window and all building masses.
repairs.source: large finance: legacy crest only for level<3
